patches_added.description: Takes the banner reminding you to be respectful off the bottom of a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Shooty Skies Ad-Free (Ads blocked + instant rewards)
patches_modified.description: Blocks banner, interstitial, app-open and native ads, and turns rewarded videos into instant rewards — nothing is ever fetched or displayed.

patches_modified.name: Shooty Skies Free store
patches_modified.description: Every store item is free — tap "Buy" and the purchase completes instantly with no Google Play payment, and owned items like ad removal are granted at startup.

patches_modified.name: Free Store
patches_modified.description: Everything in the shop is granted instantly and free — double coins, more gifts and the any-purchase perks — with no Google Play payment screen, no account and nothing charged.

patches_modified.name: Instant Rewards
patches_modified.description: Rewarded videos give their reward instantly — no ad ever plays. Free revive, double coins, free items, etc. all work without watching anything.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Forced ads are gone for good — interstitials never load or show, even offline and regardless of server settings. Rewarded videos you choose to watch still work.

patches_modified.name: Fancy Pants Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium, wardrobe, world 1 and world 2 by forcing OTTBilling.isPurchased to always return true.

patches_modified.name: Lemmings: Native Grant Hook
patches_modified.description: Store items grant instantly when tapped, through the game's own reward system — no purchase flow is ever started, nothing is charged, and purchase-failure popups are removed.

patches_modified.name: Lemmings: VIP Unlock
patches_modified.description: Unlocks VIP status without paying. VIP banners, rewards and bonuses show as active — no subscription needed.

patches_modified.name: Vita Mahjong Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes banners and interstitials and makes rewarded ads pay out instantly without a video. Ad-gated buttons stay usable even when no ad is filled or the placement config is missing.

patches_modified.name: Vita Mahjong Restore Purchases
patches_modified.description: On a fresh install, "Restore Purchases" reports the no-ads pack and the yearly VIP subscription as already owned, so those entitlements activate without a real Google Play purchase.

patches_modified.name: All items owned
patches_modified.description: Every gun, skin, glove and drone shows as unlocked, and you can equip any of them. Your save file is not changed.

patches_modified.name: Instant rewarded video
patches_modified.description: Rewards from "watch an ad" popups are granted immediately, without playing an ad.
patches_modified.previous_description: Reward buttons pay out instantly. Tap once and you get the reward, with no ad to watch.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited currency
patches_modified.description: Your cash, gold and diamonds always show the maximum. You never run short of money.

patches_modified.name: Swift Backup Local Cloud Metadata
patches_modified.description: Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on the device and the connected cloud instead of the Swift Backup server.

patches_modified.name: Swift Backup Premium Unlock
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Premium features.

patches_modified.name: Swift Backup Tamper Protection
patches_modified.description: Stops the app from closing itself on patched installs.

patches_modified.name: Swift Backup Web Login
patches_modified.description: Makes Google sign-in work for connecting cloud accounts.

patches_modified.name: Missiles Ads Removal
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the Google Mobile Ads Unity bridge (AdMob): interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, app open and banner ads resolve instantly as loaded/showed/closed/rewarded without ever displaying an ad.

patches_modified.name: Missiles Billing Bypass
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the Google Play Billing 8.0.0 purchase flow: every buy is instantly granted (fake Purchase delivered through the registered listener), purchases/consumes complete instantly, and the product catalog is served with fake ProductDetails — no Google Play sheet, no real payment.

patches_modified.name: Missiles License Bypass
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the Pairip Play Store license check so the app launches normally.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the script for games inside LIVEs and turns off animated gift effects. It saves very little space. The catch: LIVE games and animated gifts may stop working. Co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, invitations and battle scores aren't touched.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_modified.name: Modern UI
patches_modified.description: [v1.3.6: Classic Joey can be turned back on. The Joey bird image in sidebar can be toggled on when using ModernUI. Performance improvements for Modern UI. Post style settings are back, without post layout, thumbnail side, or corner roundness. Thumbnail post style ui fixes.] With ModernUI layout turned on (on by default) Joey's own themes and colour changes are turned off. ModernUI layout patch includes Aqua (default), Blue, Purple, Coral, Mint, Gold, Amber, Black, Sky, and AMOLED black themes and can be set in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings. Posts use one compact list, so card and compact are no longer separate. Various customisable UI options are in Morphe Settings. The media viewer has its first UI tweaks in this release, including bigger icons and a full screen view.

Various customisable UI options are in Morphe Settings. The media viewer has its first UI tweaks in this release, including bigger icons and a full screen view.
